Khushi woh nahi jo aapko chahiye. Yeh woh hai jo aapke paas hai usse chahna.
Aazadi galat hone ka haq hai, galat karne ka haq nahi.
True explorers ko free spirit ke alawa kuch nahi chahiye.
Khushi raasta hai.
Khushi poori tarah khud hona hai.
Duniya mein sirf ek hi joy hai – shuru karna.
Khushi ek billi ki tarah hai, agar aap isko manayenge, toh yeh bhagegi.
Apni freedom pane ke liye apna rasta bhool jao.
Khushi ek garam dil hai.
Khushi durlabh hai.
Azadi kaam karne ka adhikar hai.
Azadi ek rashtra ki saans hai.
Khushi ek man ki sthiti hai, aur kuch nahi.
Khushi kripa par swabhavik pratikriya hai.
Happiness ek naye time zone mein uthna hai.
Khushi pyar hai.
Joy dil ki sadgi hai.
Khushi ab hai.
Khushi tab hai jab zindagi zarooratein poori kare.
Khushi komal hai.
Azaadi manav vikas ka antim lakshya hai.
Fikr mat karo, khush raho.
Azaadi ek keemti cheez hai.
Unke shukraguzar ho jo hamein khush rakhte hain; woh hamari rooh ko khilate hain.
Khushi divya shakti ki shaant maujoodgi hai.
Khushi pyaar ki shuddh jhalak hai.
Horizon hi mera akela boss hai.
Routine todo, apni freedom ko feed karo.
